method: Native T3 browser on isolated ?review=polish. Keyboard events drive controls; deterministic debug.advance steps the same production simulation because host paint cadence was throttled. Campaign uses scene placement and controlled guardian/boss damage; this is not a manual complete combat playthrough. Rendering counters in campaign state are not performance benchmarks.
limitations: No sustained hardware FPS claim. Native preview host and DPR changed during testing.
Rigid articulated meshes remain; this is not a completed AAA art or animation system.
Representative obstacles and automated geometric cases were tested, not every possible world trajectory.
